---
title: Ethics and rate limits
---

The nostalgia index pulls its data from the [Wikimedia REST API](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/), a free public service. This page covers how the package keeps its requests polite and how to make them identify you.

## Identifying your requests

Wikimedia's [User-Agent policy](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Wikimedia_Foundation_User-Agent_Policy) asks every client to send a descriptive `User-Agent` header with contact information. The package sends one with every request, but the default contains placeholder contact details. Edit `USER_AGENT` in `nostalgia_index.client` to use your own project URL and email.

## Keeping request volume low

The package requests only `agent=user` data, which excludes spiders. Historical pageviews don't change, so responses are cached on disk and each article and date range is downloaded only once. The cache lives in `~/.cache/nostalgia_index`; set the `NOSTALGIA_CACHE_DIR` environment variable to store it somewhere else.

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace', "darkMode":true}}}%%
flowchart TD
    REQ(["fetch_views"])
    HIT{"in disk cache?"}
    CACHE[("cached frame")]
    CALL["GET with User-Agent<br>agent=user"]
    ST{"status"}
    BACK["exponential backoff<br>up to 4 retries"]
    NF["empty frame + warning"]
    OK["parse and cache"]
    REQ --> HIT
    HIT -- yes --> CACHE
    HIT -- no --> CALL --> ST
    ST -- "429 / 5xx" --> BACK --> CALL
    ST -- 404 --> NF
    ST -- 200 --> OK

style REQ fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style HIT fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style CACHE fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style CALL fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style ST fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style BACK fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style NF fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
style OK fill:#ffbe00,color:#1e1c21,rx:5,ry:5
```

When the API responds with a 429 (too many requests) or a server error (500, 502, 503, or 504), the request is retried with exponential backoff, up to four times.

## Recap

Replace the placeholder contact details in `USER_AGENT` before making regular requests. The disk cache and backoff retries keep load on Wikimedia low, and `NOSTALGIA_CACHE_DIR` controls where cached responses are stored.
